intro: Taipei rewards visitors with cheap, clean transit, superb food and green hills on its doorstep. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: MRT is clean, safe and cheap: NT$20-65 per ride, trains about 06:00-00:00.
EasyCard gives 20% off MRT rides and NT$7 bus transfers within an hour.
City buses are frequent; pay with EasyCard on boarding.
Taxis are metered and plentiful; Uber operates in Taipei.
Driving is not advised for visitors; parking is hard and scooters dominate.
YouBike share bikes are widely available; sidewalks are good for walking.

taipei101.name: Taipei 101
taipei101.price_text: ≈ TWD 600 observatory ticket · check on the day
taipei101.hours: Observatory daily, roughly 11:00–21:00 · check on the day
taipei101.tip: Go up late afternoon to catch daylight and sunset in one visit.

npm.name: National Palace Museum
npm.price_text: ≈ TWD 350 adult · check on the day
npm.hours: Daily roughly 09:00–17:00 · closed some Mondays, check on the day
npm.tip: Pick three or four galleries only; the collection is huge and tiring.

cks.name: Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall
cks.tip: Come early morning to watch locals practise tai chi on the square.

shilin.name: Shilin Night Market
shilin.price_text: Pay per stall · most snacks TWD 50–150
shilin.tip: Bring small cash and share dishes so you can try more stalls.

longshan.name: Longshan Temple
longshan.tip: Visit at dusk when lanterns come on and worshippers chant.

ximending.name: Ximending
ximending.hours: Always open · shops from about 11:00 to 22:00
ximending.tip: Wander the small side lanes off the main pedestrian street for street food.

dihua.name: Dihua Street
dihua.tip: Buy dried fruit and tea here; the old shophouse architecture is the draw.

yehliu.name: Yehliu Geopark
yehliu.price_text: ≈ TWD 120 entry · check on the day
yehliu.tip: Half-day trip from Taipei; bring a hat as there is little shade.

jiufen.name: Jiufen Old Street
jiufen.price_text: Free to walk · tea houses charge per pot
jiufen.tip: Stay for dusk when the lanterns light up the hillside lanes.

beefnoodle.name: Beef noodle soup
beefnoodle.hours: Most shops lunch and dinner · check on the day
beefnoodle.tip: Order both braised and clear broth versions to compare.

elephant.name: Elephant Mountain trail
elephant.hours: Always open · bring a torch for the descent
elephant.tip: Start about an hour before sunset and bring water; steps are steep.

songyan.name: Eslite Spectrum Songyan
songyan.price_text: Free to enter · shops and cafes extra
songyan.tip: Good rainy-day stop; combine with the nearby Songshan cultural park.

fortsan.name: Fort San Domingo
fortsan.price_text: ≈ TWD 80 entry · check on the day
fortsan.tip: Pair with the Tamsui waterfront and a ferry ride across the river.

libertyarch.name: Liberty Square Arch
libertyarch.tip: The arch frames the memorial hall; best photo from the middle of the square.

linfamily.name: Lin Family Mansion and Garden
linfamily.price_text: ≈ TWD 80 entry · check on the day
linfamily.tip: A quiet classical garden; allow time to sit by the pond.

maokong.name: Maokong Gondola
maokong.price_text: ≈ TWD 120 one way · glass cabin costs more
maokong.hours: Roughly 09:00–21:00 · closed some Mondays, check on the day
maokong.tip: Ride up in the afternoon and have tea at a hillside tea house before returning.

nccu.name: National Chengchi University
nccu.tip: Only worth it if you have a reason to visit; it is a long ride from the centre.

ntu.name: National Taiwan University
ntu.tip: Combine with the nearby Gongguan food lanes for cheap student eats.

nationaltheater.name: National Theater
nationaltheater.price_text: Ticket prices vary by show · check the programme
nationaltheater.hours: Box office and shows in the evening · check on the day
nationaltheater.tip: Book a performance in advance; the building itself is worth a look by day.

ningxia.name: Ningxia Night Market
ningxia.price_text: Pay per stall · most snacks TWD 50–150
ningxia.tip: Smaller and easier than Shilin; try the oyster omelette stalls.

pingxi.name: Pingxi Lantern Festival
pingxi.price_text: Lantern release ≈ TWD 150–250 · festival free to watch
pingxi.hours: Festival around the Lunar New Year period · check dates
pingxi.tip: Very crowded on festival night; book transport early or go on a normal day to release a lantern.

huaxi.name: Huaxi Street Night Market
huaxi.price_text: Pay per stall · most snacks TWD 50–150
huaxi.tip: Old-school covered market next to Longshan Temple; go for the snake alley history and snacks.

daanpark.name: Daan Forest Park
daanpark.tip: A big green break with ponds and birds; good for a slow morning walk.

tamsui.name: Tamsui waterfront walk
tamsui.tip: Walk the riverside path and take the ferry to Bali for the sunset view.

foodtour.name: Old-town food walking tour
foodtour.hours: Tours usually late morning or evening · book ahead
foodtour.tip: A guided tasting around Dihua Street and Dadaocheng covers dishes you might miss alone.

beitou.name: Beitou hot spring soak
beitou.price_text: ≈ TWD 200–600 public or private bath · check on the day
beitou.tip: Easy MRT ride north; bring your own towel to save on rental fees.

p228park.name: 228 Peace Memorial Park
p228park.tip: A calm green stop between the station and the memorial hall.

stays.why: Young, busy and central. Walk to the MRT, night markets and the old Wanhua temples. Good for first-timers who want nightlife.
Quiet lanes, small shops and cafés. Two MRT lines and short rides to most sights.
Leafy and calm, near the park and Yongkang Street food. A good base for couples and slower trips.
Best for transport: MRT, trains and the airport line in one place. Practical for short stays and day trips.

food: Eat at night markets: Shilin and Raohe are the big ones. Go hungry, share dishes, and carry small cash.
Try the classics: beef noodle soup, soup dumplings, oyster omelette, stinky tofu and shaved ice.
Yongkang Street in Da'an is good for a sit-down food walk with tea shops and dessert.
Convenience stores are cheap and open late. A quick meal or snack costs about NT$60–150.
Many small eateries are cash-first. Keep some TWD on you; card use is common but not everywhere.
more_time: Add a day trip to Jiufen and the coast by bus or train; check times on the day.
Take a hot-spring trip to Beitou on the MRT, about 30 minutes from the center.
Swap one city day for the National Palace Museum if you like art and history; allow half a day.
